content.text: {"id": "mm5651a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Of 266 participants, 103 (39%) met the case definition."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The attack rate (AR) among respondents was 39% overall"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The attack rate (AR) among respondents was 39% overall"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Classroom ARs ranged from 18% (kindergarten classroom G) to 71% (first-grade classroom J)."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The attack rate (AR) among respondents was 39% overall"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "ARs did not differ significantly between students and staff members or between females and males"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "being in first-grade classroom J (AR = 71%; relative risk [RR] = 1.9; 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.3--2.8)"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Using a multivariable model, being in classroom J and having an ill contact also were the only two independent and significant risk factors"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "outbreak investigation", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "was notified of an outbreak of acute gastroenteritis in an elementary school"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "A questionnaire was developed to use in a cohort study of all staff members and students."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Two factors were significantly associated with illness in bivariate analyses (p<0.05, Fisher's exact test)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Using a multivariable model"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "after backward elimination"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
